_frame_metadata.purpose: Project structure and module map for AI assistants
_frame_metadata.forAI: Read this file FIRST when starting work on this project. It contains the module structure, data flow, and conventions. Update this file when you add new modules or change the architecture.

engine.py.purpose: Central orchestrator — registers monitors/sweeps, runs sweep cycles, enriches and calibrates findings, dispatches callbacks

models.py.purpose: Core data models — Finding (with dedup hash, confidence, triage, MITRE/OWASP fields) and ModuleResult

db.py.purpose: Thread-safe SQLite storage with deduplication, migrations, trend data, and precision stats

config.py.purpose: Centralized paths (OpenClaw home, audit data), permission expectations, insecure config rules

ioc.py.purpose: Hardcoded IOC database (C2 IPs, malicious domains, publishers, reverse shell patterns) with match aging and confidence scoring

alerting.py.purpose: Alert dispatcher — sends critical findings to Slack, Telegram, macOS notifications, or file with cooldown deduplication

mappings.py.purpose: Centralized MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP ASI, confidence, and remediation mappings for all finding types

learner.py.purpose: Precision tracker — calibrates finding confidence from human triage feedback (confirmed vs false_positive)

profile.py.purpose: Environment profiler — detects installed components (Docker, MCP, skills, gateway) to skip irrelevant sweeps

report.py.purpose: Jinja2 HTML report generator with 30-day trend charts and security score display

remediate.py.purpose: Auto-remediation engine — permission tightening, config hardening, malicious skill quarantine

daemon.py.purpose: Unix double-fork daemonization, PID file management, signal handling, log setup

ioc_updater.py.purpose: External threat intel feed ingestion — merges URL/file IOC data with custom IOC store

monitors/base.py.purpose: Abstract base class for always-on threaded monitors with finding callback

sweeps/base.py.purpose: Abstract base class for periodic sweeps with timing wrapper

sweeps/correlation.py.purpose: Multi-indicator attack chain detection — 6 patterns (active breach, privilege escalation, supply chain, exfiltration, coordinated attack, escalating threat)

sweeps/skill_scanner.py.purpose: Scans installed skills for C2 IPs, AMOS indicators, reverse shells, exfiltration endpoints

sweeps/security_score.py.purpose: Weighted 0-135 security score across 17 checks with A-F grade
